messages:
Leah (growth): Heads-up from CS: a few prospects hit the pricing calculator and got totals that looked "too high" because networking and reserved capacity weren't clearly surfaced. They then clicked the self-serve CTA and AEs were surprised. Can we add clearer breakdowns and a routing rule for >$5k/mo?
Omar (pm): Thanks. Do we have concrete repros? Is the calc summing the wrong buckets or just hiding line items?
Leah (growth): Repro on a customer profile: Hosted base + Dedicated burst + private peering yields ~6k estimate. The calculator currently shows only the aggregate number and an ambiguous "est." label.
Rina (design): Suggestion: expose collapsed "Invoice preview" with line items: Compute (reserved/spot), Networking (egress, peering), Support, Optional add-ons. Add a small "Why this matters" tooltip. Also change CTA behavior when total > threshold.
Becca (ops): If we change routing, we need an idempotent hook into intake. We should emit a distinct event (pricing_calc_submitted) and a boolean high_touch that ops can listen for to create leads. Also would be good to gate behind a FF.
Jamal (sales): Absolutely. For any high_touch lead (> $5k/mo) create a Salesforce lead and tag channel AE_queue. Prefer CTA copy: "Request quote & demo" instead of generic "Contact us". Also have the form ask one quick qualifier: expected monthly tokens.
Nneka (content): Drafting FAQ lines: "Why does my estimate include networking?" -> "We include outbound egress and private network proxies for Dedicated/Private deployments; select 'Get a quote' for a detailed invoice." I'll prepare two microcopy variants for the CTA and the tooltip.
Omar (pm): Proposed AB test: Variant 1 = show full invoice preview by default, Variant 2 = keep it collapsed but show an explicit 'View details' link. Metric: increase in demo bookings and decrease in surprised AE handoffs. Run 3-4 weeks.
Rina (design): I'll mock both flows. Also propose different label set: instead of Starter/Standard/Enterprise, use deployment-first labels: "Hosted (pay-as-you-go)", "Dedicated (reserved)", "Private (VPC/on-prem)". Users found traditional tier names confusing when mixed with deployment modes.
Becca (ops): I'll add the feature flag and wire analytics. Events: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_result with { total_usd, components, high_touch }. We'll stream to BigQuery and to our internal lead queue.
Jamal (sales): For intake form: fields = company size, monthly tokens, compliance needs, preferred contact method. If they choose "Request quote & demo" auto-schedule a meeting link with AE pool.
Nneka (content): I'll put the FAQ + CTA wording drafts in #marketing-assets by EOD. Also drafting sample invoice PDF to link from the FAQ.
Dev-Bot: CI passed for branch/pricing-calc-invoice-preview, deploying to staging.
Leah (growth): Action list: Nneka write copy (EOD), Rina provide mocks (48h), Becca FF + analytics, Omar owns AB test config and rollout timeline, Jamal finalizes intake requirements. Check-in next Thu to approve launch to prod. Thanks all :raised_hands:
